cv:
Mateus Oliveira · Backend engineer · Recife, Brazil
Logistics company (2020 – present, 6 years): delivery-exception assistant with LLMs, Go, Python.
reply:
Hi Sofia,

1. I built an assistant that reads delivery-exception notes from drivers and drafts the customer message and the next action. 120 support agents use it, and I owned the pipeline end to end.
2. Every week 50 drafts are reviewed by team leads with a 4-point rubric; the share rated good went from 65% to 87% in four months, and we keep the reviewed drafts as a regression set.
3. Driver notes are very short and full of slang; we built a glossary the model receives with each note.
4. Delivery times and addresses come from our tracking API; the model never computes them.
5. Recife, Brazil. $34/h. English 8/10. 6 hours of overlap with US Eastern.

Thanks,
Mateus
